node.statement: For an arbitrary projection-basis element e_j of C^m, dim S_{w(e_j)}>1 is impossible. Indeed, if dim S_{w(e_j)}>1, lem-maincb-stage1-strict-refinement, applied to the same fixed W,A,epsilon,w and this j, produces a map w_+:C^{m+1}->A which is an extended W.c0_cb*epsilon-inclusion in the precise sense of def-extended-delta-inclusion and satisfies ||w_+(I_{C^{m+1}})-I_A|| <= W.c0_cb*epsilon. Thus w_+ is an admissible map of source dimension m+1, contradicting directly the node-1 hypothesis that w has maximum source dimension among all such maps. Hence not(dim S_{w(e_j)}>1).
